proposals.title: 运行中 Compile data 与启动编译检查的删除、异常、地图导入门未闭合
proposals.impact: MEDIUM: consumers may apply startup cleanup/repair behavior to a different reachable entry.
proposals.preconditions: Compatible complete hypothetical host/project; menu reachable; ordinary current definitions, no extension; PBS directory exists; previous .dat outputs valid. Observe compiler/menu prefix only, not unverified final host error UI. Fixed supplied Demo lacks host maps/system/tilesets and was not run.
proposals.ordinary_control: Same menu with all valid inputs runs ordered PBS/animation/map/text stages and reaches completion message; startup main additionally performs discovery/import/mtime/delete before full stages.
proposals.minimal_counterexample: After valid types/abilities producers save new files, a later invalid move record throws before moves save. Direct Compile data retains the previous moves.dat, with already rewritten earlier files; it never traverses startup listed-file cleanup. A newly copied unregistered map is also not imported by this menu entry.
proposals.partial_commit_exception_boundary: Direct entry neither pre-deletes all listed outputs nor wraps the stages in Compiler.main diagnostic/cleanup/conversion. Already cleared/registered tables and earlier saves remain; failing table may retain old disk output while memory is partial. Completion/disposal after the throw is not guaranteed. Outer game error handling is separate; diagnostic may itself fail per existing WP07.

negative_evidence.range: Entire 001_Compiler.rb 1-1117 and 004_Compiler_MapsAndEvents.rb1-1751, menu1335-1344 and dispatcher69-146; full Data/Scripts literal compile_all/caller search.
negative_evidence.result: Only startup main and direct menu full-stage callers located. Direct call bypasses preflight. No local rescue/cache clear added by dispatcher.
negative_evidence.limit: No statement about dynamic plugin or external reflective callers; no error UI execution.

proposals.minimal_revision_scope: WP75 should explicitly distinguish direct runtime menu stages from WP04 startup check; WP04 exception/delete paragraphs retain startup scope and reference direct-entry difference. This is a coverage-gap proposal, not a claim that scoped startup clauses are themselves false.
acceptance_vectors: Runtime direct failure after successful prefix: earlier outputs new, failing output old, no main cleanup; startup same failure under successful diagnostics: listed files deletion attempted.
Unregistered map: startup importer registers it; runtime direct Compile data does not call importer.
Valid direct run reaches completion; all vectors NOT_EXECUTED.
proposals.future_implementation_policy: Document fixed reference behavior; do not repair reference or prescribe future implementation.

proposals.title: 运行中编译不失效区域图鉴/连接/动画缓存；随后图鉴反写可恢复旧内容
proposals.impact: MEDIUM: disk compilation success does not imply same-session consumers refresh; cached dex export can overwrite newly authored input.

formal.clause: Purpose: when compiled data becomes effective

proposals.preconditions: Complete compatible hypothetical host and successful full stages; cached region0 initially contains only registered BULBASAUR. Authored regional PBS now legally contains only registered IVYSAUR at region0; no independent cache invalidation/reinitialization or plugin action. Actual supplied Demo execution is not claimed.
proposals.ordinary_control: If regional cache is absent before compilation, first query after successful save reads IVYSAUR. Dex editor Yes explicitly clears its cache before writer; startup Game.initialize constructs fresh Game_Temp. These are different entry conditions.
proposals.minimal_counterexample: Runtime Compile data saves regional_dexes.dat containing IVYSAUR while existing cached region0 remains BULBASAUR. Same-session regional number/member queries still read BULBASAUR. Then Create PBS file regional_dexes export uses that cache and overwrites authored PBS with BULBASAUR; compiled disk still IVYSAUR until another compilation. Likewise preloaded animation mapping/collection and map-connection caches are not invalidated by full stages.
proposals.partial_commit_exception_boundary: Successful compilation itself updates disk/registry outputs as each producer does; it does not mutate these previously issued cache references. Subsequent export truncates the target file and has ordinary partial-write failure semantics. Neither stage rolls back authored input or automatically broadcasts refresh. Animation zero-valid-name retained disk behavior is already explicit in WP74 and must remain separate.

negative_evidence.range: Fresh full 001/002/003/004 compiler files; full MiscPBSData1-64; Game.initialize1-17; menu1335-1408; MapFactoryHelper383-428; entire reference literal pbClearData search.
negative_evidence.result: No compiler cache-clearing operation; pbClearData has definition only in fixed tracked reference search. Import clears map_infos only; editor save has explicit separate dex/connection invalidation. System.reload_cache is a host file-cache call, not a source-level Game_Temp field assignment.
negative_evidence.limit: No claim about hidden native host side effects; direct cached-reader source returns existing object; any externally supplied invalidation revokes vector premises.

proposals.minimal_revision_scope: Add a bounded same-session compilation/cache contract to WP04/WP75; replace WP74 cache row vague lifecycle management with startup-reinitialization vs direct-runtime no-invalidation distinction. State regional export cached input and staged disk/PBS/reader observations; retain existing encounter snapshot and metrics layout contracts.
acceptance_vectors: Preloaded dex A -> legal authored B -> successful direct compile: disk B / cached reader A; subsequent export PBS A / disk B.
Cache initially absent -> direct compile B -> first read B, adjacent control.
Editor Yes invalidates cache and startup reinitialization gives fresh temp; do not merge with direct compile.
Preloaded animation and connections kept after direct stage writes; zero-valid animation mapping retention remains separate. All NOT_EXECUTED.
proposals.future_implementation_policy: Document fixed reference behavior; do not repair reference or prescribe future implementation.

proposals.title: 普通 PBS 分节读取对缩进的独立注释报语法错误，与专用逐行读取不同
proposals.impact: LOW/MEDIUM: author formatting accepted by one entry can abort another before current section registration.
proposals.preconditions: Ordinary generic compiler, valid unique symbols A/B and otherwise valid fields; first column-zero section A completed at B header. Insert an ASCII-space-prefixed standalone hash comment within B; no BOM/encoding/resource or prior error. Parser shape is fixed and unoverridden.
proposals.ordinary_control: Same comment with hash in column0 is skipped. Whitespace-only physical line is skipped. Normal Name=Alpha #Beta retains Alpha and follows existing inline suffix rule. Specialized prepped-line Trainer reader skips the same standalone indented comment after preprocessing.
proposals.minimal_counterexample: In generic Type/Item/Ability-style input, a physical line containing one ASCII space then # note passes the original-line noncomment/nonblank filter; prep produces empty text; this empty result is then treated as an invalid property line and rejects. It is not skipped after preprocessing.
proposals.partial_commit_exception_boundary: A has already registered when B header was seen; B is not yielded/registered because the error occurs while collecting its content. Generic final-validation/table save not reached; A remains in current table, and outer startup/direct cleanup depends on entry COMP001. If comment precedes first section, the missing-initial-section error occurs instead.

negative_evidence.range: 001_Compiler95-135 complete generic parser and232-249 complete active prepped reader; all four Compiler files and active helper caller search.
negative_evidence.result: Generic original-line gate occurs before preprocessing and lacks a second empty test; specialized path gate occurs after preprocessing.
negative_evidence.limit: No claim that all parsers reject indented comments or actual shipped PBS contains them; zero authored-file corpus assertion.

proposals.minimal_revision_scope: Add one implementation-independent author-input boundary to WP04 distinguishing column-zero comments/blank physical lines/inline comments/indented standalone comments by parser family; add before-section and mid-section prefix cases, without prescribing parser internals.
acceptance_vectors: Generic A/B fixture with indented standalone hash: A registered, B not, final save not called.
Column-zero hash/blank physical line controls compile normally; specialized trainer prepped input accepts same comment.
Before first generic section: initial-section rejection, different location; all NOT_EXECUTED.
proposals.future_implementation_policy: Document fixed reference behavior; do not repair reference or prescribe future implementation.
